_comment: Shared vectors for the hostname selection rule of IP-mode projects: recon_settings/ip_hostnames.py (read by recon/tests, recon_orchestrator/tests and agentic/tests test_ip_hostname_vectors.py) and its TypeScript mirror webapp/src/lib/ipHostnameFilter.ts (ipHostnameFilter.test.ts). A copy that disagrees with one vector fails. 'address' and 'post_probe' are Python-only (the webapp preview does no DNS and no probe). In 'evaluate', each vector is merged over evaluate_defaults; the TS preview is fed each name's 'last_run' reason, else its expected reason, as its last-run reason, and 'preview' lists where the preview legitimately differs from a run. 'psl' is what a caller with a Public Suffix List (the webapp) expects instead. Documentation addresses, reserved names and bare public suffixes only, never a real target.
